mapper.select: select 100-sum(nvl(PRIN_AMT,0)) from FIN_CASH_PLAN where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and MDATE <= to_date(#{sysdate},'yyyy-mm-dd') group by FINPROD_ID

SELECT REAL_NAME realName FROM SYS_USER
USER_NAME = #{userName}
SELECT CLOSE_PRICE FROM (SELECT * FROM MST_BOND_MARK_INFO_FULL WHERE SEC_ID = #{finprodMarketId} AND VALUE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysdate},'yyyy-mm-dd') ORDER BY VALUE_DATE DESC) WHERE ROWNUM =1
SELECT NETPRICE FROM (SELECT NETPRICE FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO WHERE SEC_ID = #{finprodMarketId} AND VALUE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{sysdate},'yyyy-mm-dd') ORDER BY VALUE_DATE DESC) WHERE ROWNUM =1

SELECT SUM(NVL(PSPF.AMOUNT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM TRD_STASEC_FLOW tsf LEFT JOIN TRD_STASEC_FLOW_DETAIL tsfd ON tsfd.SEQNO = tsf.SEQNO AND tsfd.BRANCH = '0' LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW PSPF ON TSF.SEQNO = PSPF.TRADE_ID AND PSPF.FINPROD_ID = tsfd.FINPROD_ID AND TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID = PSPF.PORTFOLIO_ID AND TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID = PSPF.SEC_ACCT_ID AND TSF.CDATE = PSPF.CDATE WHERE tsf.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PSPF.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PSPF.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PSPF.INV_AIM = #{invAim,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tsf.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and (TSF.ps = '01' or not exists (select 1 from PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW pspf where TSF.SEQNO = PSPF.TRADE_ID and pspf.hoding_type='13'))
SELECT Distinct VDATE FROM FIN_PRODUCT where FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
